message.name: CorporateActionInstructionCancellationRequest002V13
message.definition: Scope|The CorporateActionInstructionCancellationRequest message is sent by an account owner to an account servicer to request cancellation of a previously sent corporate action election instruction.|Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent (the sub-function of the message is Duplicate),|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy),|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy Duplicate), using the relevant elements in the business application header (BAH).

rules.name: WithLinkageRule
rules.text: If Code WITH is used, then the one or more instruction which are linked become bound and which must be executed together. Even if one single transactions/instructions/notifications can not be executed, then all the other transactions/instructions/notifications must also be kept pending. Therefore the use of code WITH must be limited to combine up to 2 or 3 transactions/instructions/notifications.

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: If Code is present, the code OTHR must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate. ||If Code is present, the code CHAN must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. ||If Code is present, the code REDM must only be used when the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When a ISIN code exist, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: EventType/Code OTHR must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate. |EventType/Code CHAN must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. |EventType/Code REDM must only be used when the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

rules.name: OfficialCorporateActionEventReference
rules.text: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the structure and usage of the Official Corporate Action Event Reference (COAF). Those recommendations are|available in the SMPG Global Market Practices Part 1 document on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: SafekeepingPlaceRule
rules.text: The SafekeepingPlace is only to be used by global custodians that allow their clients to specify where the securities are to be held, for example, in an ICSD account versus an account at the local CSD.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present then SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, then BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: OptionNumber1Rule
rules.text: For differentiation between options, the OptionNumber must be used (preferred rather than the OptionType for example in the case where two or more offers can be described by the same corporate action option code). Therefore, the OptionNumber value must be different for each option.

rules.name: OptionNumber2Rule
rules.text: When the CorporateActionInstruction is unsolicited, that is, the instruction has not been preceded by an Corporate ActionNotification, then OptionNumber/code must be UNSO (unsolicited).

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: ChangeInstructionIndicatorGuideline
rules.text: ChangeInstructionIndicator may only be used if CorporateActionOptionDetails/WithdrawalAllowedIndicator was set to 'false' or '0' (No) in the CorporateActionNotification message previously received and if CorporateActionOptionDetails/ChangeAllowedIndicator was set to 'true' or '1' (Yes) in the CorporateActionNotification message previously received.

rules.name: CorporateActionEventIdentificationRule
rules.text: If the CorporateActionInstruction message was unsolicited (that is, this instruction has not been preceded by a CorporateActionNotification), then, CorporateActionGeneralInformation/CorporateActionEventIdentification must be NONREF.

rules.name: BeneficialOwnerBreakdownRequestRule
rules.text: If CorporateActionInstruction/OptionType/Code value is BOBD (BeneficialOwnerBreakdownRequest), then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code value must be WTRC (Withholding Tax Relief Certification).|(MT565 NVR C8)
